async function obtainEightRawIron(bot) {
    // The function first checks if eight raw iron items are already present in the inventory; if so, it stops. It then attempts to equip a suitable pickaxe, such as iron, stone, or copper. If the goal is not met, it enters a loop to explore and search again for more ore. If all attempts fail to gather the required amount, an error is thrown.
